ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-intensity (white/light-grey) ratio of approximately 0.05:1 within the fluke boundaries.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinguishable light-grey mottled blobs are located in the perimedial region adjacent to the notch and at the distal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate pixel-calculated vertex angle of 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; deep-amplitude jagged peaks are concentrated on the distal margins, particularly a significant 'step' notch on the far left lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending towards the distal tips, with a sharpening slope at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of roughly circular, high-contrast light-grey pixel clusters located on the right lobe near the distal tip; smaller punctate clusters are visible near the base of the median notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Single high-intensity vertical linear mark on the right lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip, originating from the trailing edge boundary.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep jagged tissue loss/irregularity on the distal tip of the left lobe, appearing as an atypical stepped amputation of the edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced sawtooth serration pattern on the far-left lateral margin of the trailing edge.
